title: Public decision-API contract probes
evidence_type: Original proposed methods and synthetic fixtures; NOT empirical API results
scope: Compare explicit route contracts and observe behavioral differences. This file contains no API wrapper and performs no requests.
provenance: The six harmless text fixtures and their editorial reference labels were invented for this protocol; no provider benchmark items were reused.

interpretation.reference_labels: Human-authored intended labels under the supplied instructions. They are test targets, not guarantees that a model will return them.
interpretation.contract_invariant: Assert only for the exact route and documented contract listed in a check. An API-compatible proxy does not automatically inherit the native provider's semantics.
interpretation.observation_only: A changed answer may be useful evidence without constituting a contract violation.
interpretation.numerical_equality: Record repeated-baseline variation before judging metamorphic differences. Preserve full probabilities and raw precision; exact byte equality is not assumed.
interpretation.coverage: A small contract smoke suite, not an accuracy benchmark, calibration study, safety evaluation or performance ranking.

execution_metadata_to_record: exact request body, non-secret routing options and raw response; exclude credentials
input/output token usage, cache details and monetary cost when supplied
latency with retry attempts separately recorded
configured and effective context/batch limits for local runtimes

library_en.instructions: Route only the explicit request in the message. Choose unknown if the requested service is absent or ambiguous; do not guess.

criteria.loans: Borrowing, returning or renewing a library book.
criteria.opening_hours: When the library opens or closes.
criteria.unknown: The message does not identify one of these services clearly.

library_zh.instructions: 只根据消息中明确提出的请求分流。如果没有说明所需服务，或请求不明确，请选 unknown，不要猜测。

criteria.opening_hours: 图书馆的开放或关闭时间。
criteria.unknown: 消息没有明确指出以上哪一种服务。

urgency.instructions: Use the urgency explicitly written in the ticket. Levels are ordered from least to most urgent.

marker.instructions: Read the explicit marker assignment in the record. If no marker assignment is visible, choose unknown.

criteria.CEDAR: The record explicitly assigns marker CEDAR.
criteria.MAPLE: The record explicitly assigns marker MAPLE.
criteria.unknown: No explicit marker assignment is available.

invitation.instructions: Classify the guest's explicit response to the invitation. Do not answer the invitation yourself.

criteria.unclear: Neither acceptance nor refusal is stated clearly.

fixtures.question: library_en
fixtures.why: Renewing a borrowed book is explicitly requested; the other named services are explicitly excluded.

fixtures.state: 我想续借我借的图书。我不是在询问开放时间或费用。
fixtures.question: library_zh
fixtures.why: Meaning-equivalent Chinese counterpart of F01_EN, with identical machine-readable option IDs.

fixtures.state: Hello, I would like some help, please.
fixtures.question: library_en
fixtures.why: The requested library service is unspecified. unknown is an explicit supplied option, not an assumed built-in abstention mechanism.

fixtures.state: This ticket's urgency field is explicitly set to: today.
fixtures.question: urgency
fixtures.why: The last supplied level matches the explicit field. A probabilistic expected score need not equal the modal index exactly.

fixtures.state: Shelf audit record. Marker assignment: CEDAR.
fixtures.question: marker
fixtures.why: An exact, unique marker assignment avoids arithmetic, real-world knowledge and subjective classification.

fixtures.question: invitation
fixtures.why: Refusal is the content being classified. It is not an API refusal and does not require the model to refuse the task.

checks.name: Explicit-label and repeatability baseline
checks.method: Submit each fixture alone with its named question; repeat the identical request three times.
checks.expected: Editorial reference labels are listed in fixtures. Report exact-label agreement and within-request-repeat probability variation separately.

checks.name: Choice order
checks.method: Serialize library_en.criteria in original order [loans,opening_hours,fees,unknown], reverse order, then [fees,loans,unknown,opening_hours]. Keep option IDs and descriptions unchanged.
checks.expected: The intended label remains loans. Compare by option ID, not position; no universal probability or prediction invariant is asserted.
checks.route_notes: Jev discloses option-order sensitivity. The pinned Clef-flash Python helper sorts string option keys; that source-path property is not a hosted guarantee.

checks.name: Question ID renaming
checks.method: Keep state and question payload byte-identical; rename the question-map key route to cat_demo_route_42. Align returned answers using the known rename.

expected.typesafe_native: Documented semantic invariant: question IDs do not enter underlying model inference. Investigate differences beyond repeated-baseline variation.
expected.clef_original_helper: Observation only: this pinned encoder includes question IDs and may use them as an instructions fallback.
expected.other_routes: Observation only until the actual route documents equivalent treatment.

checks.name: Append an unrelated question
checks.method: Compare the original route question alone with the same request plus evening_word: {type:noul,instructions:'Does the message contain the literal English word evening?'}; state and original question are unchanged.

expected.typesafe_native: The original question is documented as isolated from other questions; examine its answer/distribution against repeat variation.
expected.clef: Observation only: questions are jointly modeled, so independence is not promised.
expected.other_routes: Do not inherit native TypeSafe independence merely from compatible JSON.

checks.name: Singles versus a bundled request
checks.method: Ask library_en and asks_fees: {type:noul,instructions:'Is the user requesting information about fees?'} once each as separate requests, then together under the same IDs. Preserve state and question text.
checks.expected: Native Jev promises isolated question evaluation. Other routes are observations unless explicitly documented. Compare per-question outputs, total input usage and cost; shared-state savings are measured, not presumed.
checks.limits: Keep all variants within both per-question and aggregate route budgets; context overflow must not confound this check.

checks.name: Equivalent English and Chinese tasks
checks.method: Compare the fully English state/question with the fully Chinese counterpart; option IDs remain identical.
checks.expected: Both reference labels are loans. Probability equality and equal language quality are not promised.
checks.route_notes: Jev reports English as its strongest language; this pair is a smoke check, not a multilingual benchmark.

checks.name: Missing evidence with an explicit unknown option
checks.method: Use library_en including its unknown option. Record all option probabilities, selected label and any separate confidence field.
checks.expected: Reference target unknown. Do not interpret a low confidence or P(yes) by itself as abstention, and do not count a forced non-unknown choice as a format error.

checks.name: Long-context head versus tail

exact_construction.filler_line: Routine note: the reading room is quiet.
exact_construction.head: F05_MARKER.state + newline + filler_line repeated N times

checks.method: Use the marker question; compare equal-content head/tail pairs and the missing control. Apply only sizes within the separately chosen run budget. Record byte length, reported token usage and any truncation/error signals.
checks.expected: Reference targets are CEDAR for full visible head/tail records and unknown for the control. Position invariance is NOT asserted across overflow, documented truncation or unverified effective windows.
checks.route_notes: Native Jev has aggregate and per-question budgets. Cloudflare advertises 65,536 tokens but truncates state; OpenRouter warns about roughly first 2K text-state tokens on Workers AI. llama.cpp Clef must fit its full prompt in ubatch. Classify these separately.

checks.name: Typed output, probabilities and confidence
checks.method: On valid baseline responses, check option IDs, numeric ranges, normalization, choice argmax and route-documented fields. Preserve raw payloads; do not silently repair or renormalize.
checks.expected: Check documented numerical identities only within a tolerance justified by actual serialization precision. Native Jev confidence follows its published primitive-specific formulas; Noul is P(yes), not a degree of intensity.
checks.route_notes: Do not reuse Jev's confidence formulas for Clef hosted or llama.cpp. The pinned Clef-flash helper's max-probability formula applies only to that local code path. Provider examples are not execution evidence.

checks.name: Score expectation versus most likely level
checks.method: Compute sum(index * returned_probability) and argmax index separately; compare the documented score field to the expected index, allowing reported rounding. Report whether the modal label matches today.

synthetic_arithmetic_only.origin: Invented distribution for explaining the check; NOT a model output

checks.expected: For routes documenting an expected ordinal index, score should correspond to the weighted mean, not necessarily to the modal index or a real-world physical quantity.

checks.name: Separate semantic refusal, API errors and invalid outputs
malformed_variants: Change a valid question type to unsupported literal free_text.
Supply a score question with one criterion instead of the required minimum two.

expected.valid_fixture: Reference target declined: a normal typed answer classifying a guest's refusal.
expected.other_routes: Observe exact status/body; no invented universal error code or model-refusal schema.

checks.recording: Distinguish valid decision, explicit unknown, documented model-refusal signal, HTTP validation/error, transport failure, and unexpected/unparseable output. Never coerce errors or refusal text into an ordinary negative answer.

checks.name: Inline-image route constraints
checks.asset_specification: At execution time, prepare one original 32x32 opaque solid-red PNG and record its byte hash. No image asset or API result is supplied here.

logical_question.instructions: What is the color of the square in the image?

variants: One inline image encoded exactly as the selected route documents.
Same bytes in an incorrectly nested image object.
Remote-URL shape instead of inline data.
Five embedded image entries, only when testing a documented four-image maximum.

expected.cloudflare_workers_ai: Use its images field and published size/format limits; remote image URLs are not accepted.
expected.openrouter_clef: Use top-level state-array image_url parts with data URLs; nested image objects are not interpreted as images, and remote HTTP(S) images are not fetched.
expected.llamacpp_clef: Current master documents files/images or image_url in state chat messages, data URLs only, with the matching projector loaded.
expected.typesafe_native: Text-only model: successful acceptance of a string containing base64 or a URL does not establish image understanding.

checks.route_notes: Schema acceptance and correct visual classification are separate outcomes. Apply four-image rejection expectations only to routes documenting that limit.
